scope: PWA 容器环境自动化实测验证
content: 准备 chromium 运行环境失败：failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; open //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine: The system cannot find the file specified.
conclusion: 由于 Docker 守护进程未启动，Chromium 隔离容器运行时不可用，Service Worker 注册与 PWA 交互实测保持未执行（unexecuted）状态，需后续在具备容器或真机环境时进行实测验证。
